messages:
Maria Chen: Quick huddle  we need a crisp list of what actually prevents GA flip. Two candidate blockers: telemetry fidelity for regressions, and billing/display for multi-currency in EU. Agree/disagree?
Ravi Singh: Telemetry fidelity is a hard block. Without standardized request/response events we can't validate prompt regressions or model fallbacks reliably.
Tessa Park: For pricing, can we ship with a "display-only" currency and a clear footnote? If so, that's less risky than delaying GA. Docs will need the exact wording.
Linh Nguyen: I like the display-only fallback idea. But we must ensure invoices/billing still use base currency for Dedicated customers. That needs legal/commercial guardrail.
Omar Reyes: From SRE: telemetry -> alert mapping must be in place. We need to know which events trigger paged alerts vs metrics dashboards. Otherwise oncall will be blind.
Priya (FinOps): If invoices remain in USD but we show local currency conversion, that has tax implications in certain regions. We need a one-line contract note and a support playbook for disputes. I'll draft.
Maria Chen: Proposed split: HARD BLOCKS (must before traffic): 1) canonical telemetry event set + sample payloads + alert mapping; 2) EU privacy/terms translated; 3) docs page with pricing fallback language + support playbook. SOFT BLOCKS (ship-as-flag): full UI localization, native multi-currency billing.
Ravi Singh: I'll own the telemetry spec and provide sample logs. Target: deliver schema + sample payloads by Thu EOD.
Tessa Park: Docs will draft the customer-facing fallback language and internal support runbook. Assigning to @docs-bot to open PR once copy ready.
Linh Nguyen: Legal: I'll confirm if we need contract appendix for currency disclaimers. If yes, we'll need commercial signoff. ETA: EOD Friday.
Omar Reyes: I'll produce an "alert matrix" doc that maps events to severity and retention. Will include sampling rates for high-volume events.
Priya (FinOps): Drafting contract appendix now. Also: for Dedicated customers we may need a 30-day price-change notice clause if we switch to localized billing within 30 days of GA.
Maria Chen: Good. Two procedural asks: 1) include an explicit SLO->SLA mapping doc (who owns?), 2) add a smoke verification checklist for staging that validates telemetry and display fallback.
Ravi Singh: SLO->SLA mapping  I can draft initial mapping for latency & error budgets. Will sync with @Omar for alert thresholds.
Tessa Park: Docs will add the staging smoke checklist items (visibility of converted currency, presence of privacy legal copy, and example telemetry logs).
Linh Nguyen: I'll coordinate contract wording with Priya and commercial.
Omar Reyes: One caveat: telemetry retention for raw events is expensive. Propose raw 7 days, aggregated 90 days for metrics. If product needs longer we should flag for ops cost.
Priya (FinOps): Agreed; include cost appendix. I'll estimate incremental monthly cost for keeping 30/90/365 days so product can decide.
Maria Chen: Decision thread proposal: Require before flip: telemetry spec + sample payloads + alert matrix; EU privacy/terms translations; docs with pricing fallback + support playbook; SLO->SLA mapping doc. Everything else can be feature-toggled post-flip. Any objections?
Ravi Singh: No objections. Will push spec link once ready.
Tessa Park: No objections. I'll start doc PR and ping reviewers.
Linh Nguyen: No objections pending contract appendix.
Omar Reyes: No objections, but we need signoff from oncall lead after staging run.
Priya (FinOps): OK, will finalize contract blurb and cost appendix.
docs-bot: created PR #842: "GA pricing-fallback & staging smoke doc" by Tessa Park
Maria Chen: Timeline: aim for signoff Friday 17:00 UTC. Owners: Ravi (telemetry spec), Omar (alert matrix + staging verification), Tessa (docs + PR), Linh/Priya (legal/commercial). Flag blockers ASAP.
Omar Reyes: Scheduling staging run Thu 09:00 UTC. I'll add telemetry verifier and smoke scripts.
Ravi Singh: Will add sample payloads and a small harness that injects test events into staging.
Tessa Park: I'll add the customer-facing wording and internal support script to the PR.
Linh Nguyen: Commercial will review appendix by Fri midday.
Priya (FinOps): I'll post cost numbers in the doc and a recommended default (display-only conversion + invoice in USD) unless commercial approves multi-currency.
Maria Chen: Perfect. If anything pops up escalate to #release-war-room and include the doc links. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
__note: Synthetic Slack thread generated for dataset. Reflects product/eng coordination on GA gating, telemetry, and pricing fallbacks.
